method.access: Read-only, in memory with Python zipfile after the file SHA-256 matched. Never extracted, executed, copied into source/outbox/Nix, or rewritten.
method.binding_authority: Parent re-verification at member and offset is the only binding authority. Worker reports were inputs.
method.worker_disclosure: External Gemini leaf workers read the capture contents in memory: two plan-stage jobs and one work-stage job (r6-static-seams). Each verified the SHA-256 first. No worker output is binding. SRICH-REPAIR1 plan stage: two further read-only Gemini leaf jobs (worker-srich-repair1-plan-static-inputs, worker-srich-repair1-plan-static-context) read the capture in memory after the SHA-256 check; every ui.event/validation/custom-code/scheduler fact added in that phase was re-read by the parent at member and offset. No work-stage worker was used. The closeout-stage fact ui.task_background_id was read by the parent directly (no worker). SRICH-REPAIR2 plan stage: three read-only Gemini leaf jobs (static-render-identity, static-export-order, static-move-rank) read the capture in memory after the SHA-256 check, and one Luna job stopped on quota before any work and was not retried; every fact added in REPAIR2 was re-read by the work-stage parent at member and offset, with no work-stage worker. MALFORMED-D-PREP1 plan stage: one read-only Gemini leaf job (malformed-d-static-report-codes) was launched to audit restore-path report codes, produced no output and was abandoned with cleanup proven; nothing from it is used. The report.* and restore.report_route facts were read by the work-stage parent directly, in memory after the SHA-256 check, with no work-stage worker. The closeout-stage fact report.ribbon_visibility was read by the closeout parent directly, in memory after the SHA-256 check, with no worker. MALFORMED-D-REPORT-GATE1: the observability.* facts were read by the work-stage parent directly, in memory after the SHA-256 check; no worker read the capture. MULTIPART-B-PREP1: the backup.partition_units, backup.partition_header, ui.upload_limits and restore.later_parts facts, and the re-verification of every backup.* and restore.* fact the multipart cases rely on, were read by the work-stage parent directly, in memory after the SHA-256 check; no worker read the capture.
method.offsets: Approximate character offsets in the decoded member; no code excerpts are recorded here.

statuses.VERIFIED: parent confirmed the cited fact at the member/offset
statuses.CORRECTED: parent found the reported fact inaccurate; the value here is the parent reading
statuses.UNVERIFIED: not confirmed; a case depending on it is BLOCKED_STATIC_UNVERIFIED or carries no prediction

backup.threshold_commit.value: text input onInput; saved only when the value passes range validation; coerced to a number

backup.partition.value: b += g; split when b + g + header + footer >= threshold (new chunk counted twice); header is always the Part 1 settings header length; on a split the accumulated chunks are emitted without the new chunk, which is carried with its leading comma stripped and b resets to 0; the last chunk is always appended to the current part

backup.partition_first_split.value: the leading-comma flag becomes false only after a non-split append, so a split on the first chunk emits an empty Part 1 and the next appended chunk has no separator (predicted malformed part)

backup.partition_units.value: every size in the partition predicate is a UTF-8 byte length (TextEncoder): each chunk string including its leading comma, the Part 1 settings header and the two-byte footer; each part is downloaded as a Blob of that same string, so the file bytes are its UTF-8 encoding and a byte simulation of the downloaded parts is exact for any content, not only ASCII

backup.partition_header.value: Part 1 is the settings header {"settings":{"prefs":<prefs>},"custom_code":<code>,"chunks":[ then chunks then the footer ]}; later parts use {"chunks":[ and the same footer; <prefs> is the JSON serialization of a copy of the in-memory prefs, so the threshold the export reads at its start (one_backup_file_size_in_bytes, coerced to a number on commit) appears in Part 1 as plain decimal digits

backup.partition_split_notice.value: each split raises and silently reports error code cnt_1436 through show_err_ribbon with silent:true

value.condition: the export partition split notice: the split predicate calls show_err_ribbon by its global name with silent true (same site as backup.partition_split_notice)

report.local_route.value: globalThis.err and globalThis.err_async report a caught error through the module-local error ribbon object, not through the globalThis.show_err_ribbon binding, with silent false by default; the chunks/internal.mjs copy (offset 23768) has the same module-local shape

report.ribbon_visibility.value: the module-local error ribbon object used by globalThis.err and globalThis.err_async is the same object globalThis.show_err_ribbon delegates to, so a restore-path report renders through the ui.error_ribbon path; its base show makes the ribbon visible only when neither the silent option, a truthy silent property on the caught error, nor the instance-wide prevent_subsequent_errors state is set, and the restore.report_route call sites pass no options (silent false); whether any restore-path throw carries a silent property was not audited

backup.part_contents.value: Part 1 = settings.prefs + custom_code + chunks; later parts = chunks only; chunk = data, thumbnail, file, tasks

backup.exported_theme_id.value: export blanks prefs.id_of_last_installed_theme in the exported copy (reported as a restore-side reset)

backup.filename.value: <manifest name> back up <locale date> Part <n>.json; this download path always passes a part index

backup.download_boundary.value: Blob type application/octet-stream, URL.createObjectURL, anchor download attribute, anchor click

restore.delete_before_parse.value: delete_all_backgrounds is requested before sorting, parsing or validation

restore.deletion_on_transition_end.value: delete_all_backgrounds only hides the backgrounds section; tables and tasks are cleared in the section_content transition-end callback

restore.sort.value: files sorted by /Part (\d+)/ number; unmatched names compare equal

restore.part1_gate.value: restore proceeds only if some file name includes 'Part 1.json'

restore.parse_all_first.value: every selected file is parsed (chunks counted) before any is applied; no continuity or duplicate check

restore.later_parts.value: files are applied one at a time in sorted order; only a file whose name includes Part 1.json supplies settings and custom code and clears the background and task tables; every file contributes its chunks, merged after the missing-id filter, so a repeated part adds no row already present

restore.type_gate.value: each file must have type application/json

restore.part1_clears_tables.value: Part 1 resets custom code, clears background and task tables, saves custom_code

restore.settings_replace.value: settings sent with replace:true, transform:true, transform_force:true

restore.no_version_gate.value: no version comparison before applying; schema transform forced

restore.report_route.value: restore_back_up is wrapped by err_async (cnt_1278) and its per-file read and parse by err_async (cnt_1556); the name sort (cnt_1555), the Part 1 gate test (cnt_1410) and the apply steps (cnt_1419, cnt_1418, cnt_1560, cnt_1375) by err or err_async; no restore-path site calls show_err_ribbon by name, so a restore-path report is visible to the page only as the error ribbon

merge.id_filter.value: restored backgrounds, thumbnails and files are filtered against ids in the in-memory list

merge.uniq_theme_id.value: merge de-duplicates only entries with a theme_id, keyed by theme_id; others are kept

merge.sort_no_renumber.value: merge sorts by i ascending and does not renumber

schema.unknown_prefs.value: worker reported unknown pref keys preserved; Schema.transform internals not confirmed; no prediction

schema.unknown_background_keys.value: only video_speed is migrated per background; retention of other keys not confirmed; no prediction

ui.upload_ranks.value: new rank = last rank + 1-based index (BigNumber string); id = time + random

ui.upload_limits.value: on the settings page each selected file is stored as the selected File object itself (no re-encoding) and the upload loop has no file-size check; the export base64-encodes that stored blob, so an exported row carries the uploaded bytes

ui.select_dom.value: select[name=<name>] option[value=<val>]; option val defaults to its name

ui.background_delete.value: .delete_background_btn inside the item; no confirm dialog

ui.move_prompt.value: window.prompt takes a 1-based position; the item is dropped beside the item at that position

ui.move_rank.value: new rank is the BigNumber midpoint of the neighbours (plus/minus 1 at the ends)

ui.background_select.value: clicking .ui selects the background; while the scheduler is open it sets the task background instead

ui.settings_context.value: select[name=settings_context]: global runs the global-selection reaction; selected_background only shows a notification and resets data.ui.settings_context to global. Clicking a background enters the selected_background context (offset 4900); in that context background_size/position/repeat changes go to the selected background, otherwise to global prefs (offset 8016). Closeout parent verification.

ui.readiness.value: link.hidden_roots_link_* removed from head; loading screen root shadow .loading_screen has class none

ui.error_ribbon.value: globalThis.show_err_ribbon(error, code, options); rendered in an open shadow root of div[class^=root][class*=error] .main; auto-hides

ui.custom_code.value: CodeMirror editors (html, css, js order as the accepted R1 adapter); custom_code button opens them

ui.scheduler.value: open_scheduler (mode scheduled only); inputs year (text), day_of_the_week, month, day_of_the_month (selects), time (text HH:MM:SS); add_new_task; close_scheduler

ui.visibility_conditions.value: slideshow, background_change_effect, slide_direction visible/enabled in scheduled mode; color_type, shuffle and interval not

gating.firefox_theme.value: theme_background mode, load_theme_background, link_to_theme_img and keep_old_theme_backgrounds are Chrome/Edge only

ui.data_global.value: globalThis.data is the page MobX observable; data.settings.prefs holds prefs and data.ui (reset to an empty object at settings init, internal.mjs 107063) holds in-page UI values

ui.event.select.value: select[name] is React-controlled from the input accessor; its onChange (the change event) calls the generic change, which writes event.target.value synchronously to data.settings.prefs[name], or to the data path of val_accessor, then runs the input event callback (offset 129430)

ui.event.checkbox.value: the checkbox input sits in a wrapping label with the .box span after it; the input onChange (offset 71326) writes event.target.checked through the generic change; .box has no handler of its own, so a .box click commits once through label activation

ui.event.text.value: onInput (internal2.mjs 82488) writes the raw input string to the page pref synchronously; the settings callback then validates it and, only when valid, coerces one_backup_file_size_in_bytes to a number, writes it back to data.settings.prefs and persists; year and time stay strings; invalid text stays in the page pref with warn state and is not persisted; no debounce on this path. A script property write fires no input event

ui.validation.threshold.value: string values only; invalid when below 52428800 or above 419430400 after numeric comparison; an empty string is invalid

ui.validation.year.value: valid when empty, or four digits starting with 2 and not below the current calendar year

ui.validation.time.value: valid when empty, or strict HH:MM:SS with hours 00-23 and minutes/seconds 00-59

ui.override_routing.value: background_size/position/repeat changes write data.settings.prefs and persist only when data.ui.settings_context is global; when it is selected_background they go to the selected background (IndexedDB update); in any other context nothing is written

ui.background_click.value: .ui onClick selects the background (offset 41009): unless a drag lock is set or the scheduler is open, it enters selected_background and copies the background presentation into data.ui; with the scheduler open it sets data.ui.background_id for the task. The drag lock needs mousedown plus a movement past the threshold (1199987) and document mouseup clears it (1206178). Delete and actions buttons stop propagation (30793, 27771), so they never select

ui.global_return.value: choosing settings_context global runs the global-selection reaction (offset 4019): context global and data.ui background presentation values restored from prefs; settings init runs the same reaction (1205729)

ui.control_wrapper.value: each control renders inside div.input_item with class is_disabled when not enabled or parent-disabled (is_enabled_cls 107074); settings_css.css gives is_disabled opacity 0.3 and pointer-events none; the text wrapper span.input_w carries is_in_warn_state (128955)

ui.visibility_enablement.value: slideshow visible for mode multiple_backgrounds, random_solid_color or scheduled; background_change_effect and slide_direction are children of slideshow (parent-disabled until it is checked), slide_direction also needs background_change_effect slide; home_btn_position is a child of home_btn_is_visible (1306847); parent state is refreshed synchronously inside the change callback

ui.custom_code_open.value: the custom_code button makes the editor overlay (.code_editor, offset 277209) visible and, while visible, resets every editor to the stored value (279747); the three editors are created at settings render in html, css, js order

ui.custom_code_gate.value: one editor change counter shared by all editors: a change is saved only once three earlier changes were counted; the save is one lodash debounce of 250 ms shared by all editor types (offset 1198160), so rapid changes to different editors save only the last

ui.custom_code_close.value: the overlay top control close_code_editor (span.btn_w icon button) hides the editor overlay

ui.scheduler_store.value: year, time, day_of_the_week, month and day_of_the_month are ordinary data.settings.prefs values (inputs at 1279197); adding a task copies them and data.ui.background_id into the new task and does not reset them

ui.add_task_enablement.value: add_new_task is enabled asynchronously after each scheduler change or background click: the task background preview must exist, some scheduler field must be non-empty, and no scheduler field may be in warn state

ui.task_background_id.value: data.ui starts empty on page load (chunks/internal.mjs 107091), so the task background id is unset; set_background_id is its only setter and is called only by the background select handler while the scheduler is open (41191), with the clicked background's id; it is reset only by delete all tasks (1283019), deletion of that background (1285795) and restore (1299284). Adding a task does not reset it, so a click on a different background must change it

ui.background_identity.value: each rendered .ui is inside the background item component (9940), whose onClick passes that component's own background prop to the select handler; with the scheduler open the handler sets data.ui.background_id to that prop's id (41189). The list keys each item by its background id (35764), so a DOM item and its component fiber belong to one background. React 19.2.7 (client.mjs 252880) stores a host fiber on the node under the __reactFiber$ prefix (89600, 172090); it may be the alternate copy, whose return chain reaches the same keyed item

ui.background_render_order.value: the backgrounds section renders one .ui item per entry of the current page slice, in slice order; the slice (1211418) is taken from the in-memory background collection, which is sorted by rank at load (37030) and after a move (1204895), and an upload appends ranks after the last rank (internal.mjs 100073), so the rendered order is ascending rank; 200 per page by default

ui.upload_first_rank.value: the last-rank lookup returns 0 for an empty collection, so an upload into an empty list gets ranks 1..n (offset 100073)

ui.move_neighbours.value: the move prompt with a position p before the moved item drops it left of the item at p; the drop (1204272) sets the moved rank to the BigNumber midpoint of the ranks either side of that slot and re-sorts; for the RICH seed (ranks 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 after the delete; last item to position 2) the moved rank is 1.5, giving 1, 1.5, 2, 4, 5

ui.task_add_background.value: add task copies data.ui.background_id into the new task background_id with no fallback, together with the scheduler prefs

backup.chunk_order.value: the export writes one chunk per entry of the in-memory background collection in its order, without sorting; chunk data is that entry, with its id and rank i; an entry without a stored file or thumbnail is skipped

backup.task_placement.value: each chunk tasks array holds exactly the in-memory tasks whose background_id equals that chunk background id; a task whose background is not exported is not exported

value.finding: the only code that writes a silent property onto a caught value is the base show exit rethrow, reached only with a truthy exit option or exit property; no settings-page member passes exit true or writes exit (the only ones, cnt_1163 and cnt_1373, are in background.mjs, another realm) and no bundled library names silent; premise, not proved by this audit: platform error values carry no own silent or exit property

the instance flag starts false with each page and is never cleared; its sole setter follows a show with the option set, whose sole caller is the startup unable-to-access-settings notice (only when prefs are unfilled); that show is visible, fullscreen and persistent, with no hide timer or close control, so a hidden gate reading proves the flag false; premise, not checked at runtime: the ribbon root loaded (ui.error_ribbon), since the page reads an absent root as hidden

not every restore failure reaches a page ribbon: the settings apply runs in the background realm via the update_settings_background message (cnt_1550) and get_background, whose errors are reported there and whose replies are not checked; the sentinel deletion runs in a transitionend callback outside restore_back_up; reactions to the restored state were not enumerated and silent-option wrappers (e.g. cnt_1219, cnt_1220) were not excluded

a visible non-persistent report hides after hide_delay plus highlight_time (5000 plus 300 ms; restore-path sites pass no options) and a later visible show restarts the timer; the session samples every 50 ms plus one Marionette call bounded only by its 10 s timeout, so a sample gap above 5.3 s, and so a missed ribbon, is not excluded statically
